blocks.text: There's few things in this world more beautiful than the big, bountiful blooms of a well-tended peony! But if you don't combine that careful cultivation with a solid support system, top-heavy peonies can quickly fall victim to the dreaded droop. Stop the flop with sturdy support of titanic proportions! Our Titan Peony Supports combine the strength of steel-core tubing, with life-extending poly coating to prevent the steel from chipping and fading - and making it more gentle on tender stems and fragile flowers. Super durable, UV-resistant polyethylene rings snap on wherever support is needed, and can be repositioned as your plant grows. These supports won't buckle or bend under the weight of your prize peony blooms, even when they're bowing deeply after a heavy rain. At 38" tall and with a generous 19.5" diameter, our large supports can handle the tallest, most productive peony plants.

items.label: PRODUCT DETAILS
items.value: Gardeners Supply Titan Peony Support Stake Set Protect and Support your lovely peonies on all seasons with our easy to install plant support stakes. Made with sturdy metal frame and polyethylene plastic casing which adds gentle protection to the stems and withstand the weight of your Plants. Dimensions: 19-1/2"" in diameter x 38"" H Needs Assembly

items.label: BEST USE AS
items.value: Outdoor Herbs & Flower Garden Plant Support Perfect Garden Supports for Plants such as tomato, cone flowers, salvias, roses, peonies and many more. Made with durable and weather resistant frames that can last seasons after season and won't let your Plants down. A highly recommended gardening supplies addition to keep your flower garden stand uprightly tall and bloom its full potentials.

items.label: HIGH-QUALITY BUILT
items.value: Gardener's Supply Company Exclusive Our Titan Peony Plant Support is built to last season after seasons. With its sturdy and strong frame, these supports won’t buckle or bend under the weight of your prize peony blooms, even when they're bowing deeply after a heavy rain. Rings can be set at any height, to keep pace with each growing plant Product Dimension: 19-1/2"" in diameter x 38"" H Materials: Polyethylene Casing, Tubular Steel Core

items.label: EASY TO INSTALL / USE
items.value: Simply Install the Titan Plant Support to the base soil surrounding the Peony or other Plants that needs support protection. With its strong frame built, It protects our Plants from strong winds or heavy rains and assures full growth of your lovely peonies uprightly and healthily.
